items.title: Public Meeting to Hear Applications Under Sections 17, 34 and 51 of The Planning Act
151 Bristol Street Proposed Zoning Bylaw Amendment File OZS23-012 Ward 3 - 2023-447
notes:
Ryan Mallory, Senior Development Planner, provided an overview of the 151 Bristol Street Proposed Zoning By-law Amendment.

Jeff Buisman, agent for the application, explained the application. 

Carolin Bott expressed concerns with the proposed increase in density, removal of trees on the property, parking, and entry to the lot.

items.title: Public Meeting Report 14 Stevenson Street North Official Plan and Zoning Bylaw Amendments OZS23-011 - 2023-443
notes:
Ryan Mallory, Senior Development Planner, provided an overview of the 14 Stevenson Street North proposed Official Plan and Zoning Bylaw Amendments.

Hugh Handy, GSP Group and Hamid Bahrami, HB Developments, agents for the application, explained the application. 

Stefano Zicarelli, asked questions related to the proximity of the development to Metrolinx railway tracks, and the impact of proximity to development on their own property. 

Pranav Sharma, expressed concerns with the impacts of grading, the height of the proposed development, the increased density, parking, and impacts on their property and the neighbourhood.

motions.item_title: Authority to move into closed meeting

motions.text: That the City Clerk be authorized to publish and serve notice of intention to designate 331 Clair Road East pursuant to Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act.
